types.SMPS: Switch-mode power supply (chargers, adapters, LED drivers, TV/PC supplies): blown fuse or fusible resistor, shorted bridge rectifier, degraded bulk capacitor, shorted switching MOSFET or transistor, open startup resistor, PWM controller without supply, optocoupler or TL431 feedback, shorted secondary diodes, dried output capacitors. Measure first unplugged: fuse continuity, diode tests on the bridge and the MOSFET, resistance of the primary; voltages only when essential.
types.TV_MONITOR: TV or monitor main board, T-con or LED backlight board: missing supply rail (12 V, 5 V, 3.3 V, 1.x V core), shorted rail capacitors, failed DC-DC converter or linear regulator, panel bias converter (VGH, VGL, VCOM) on T-cons, open LED string or boost MOSFET/diode on backlight boards, loose flex or connector. Firmware, BGA chips and the panel itself cannot be fixed with a multimeter. Measure first unplugged: resistance to ground of each rail (a short reads a few ohms) and diode tests on converter diodes; then low-voltage rails with the unit on.
types.INVERTER_APPLIANCE: Motor or compressor inverter (washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners): shorted IPM or IGBT module (diode test of each phase U, V, W against P and N), degraded DC bus capacitors, blown fuse or inrush NTC, open shunt or current-sense resistor, missing 15 V gate driver supply, Hall or position sensor. The DC bus holds about 310 V: it must be discharged and checked at 0 V before touching.
types.CONTROL_BOARD: Appliance control board (relays, triacs, microcontroller): small switch-mode or capacitive-dropper supply (dropper capacitor, zener, regulator), relay with open coil or welded contacts, failed triac or its driver transistor, missing 5 V or 3.3 V for the microcontroller, crystal, NTC or sensor inputs, burnt tracks. Capacitive-dropper boards are not isolated from mains: the whole board is PRIMARY.
types.AUDIO_AMP: Audio amplifier: shorted output transistors or amplifier IC, open emitter resistors, missing or unbalanced supply rails (+V and -V), DC offset at the speaker output (should be near 0 V), degraded filter capacitors, protection relay. Measure first unplugged: diode tests on the output transistors and resistance of the emitter resistors.
types.OTHER: Other kind of board: rely on what is visible (damage, power entry, regulators, big capacitors, connectors), prefer measurements with the unit unplugged and be conservative.
